A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study, with matching authors, methods, experiments, and appendices A–D. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison of the equations, tables, figures, and supplementary material.

before.justification: v3 reports original experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet, including temperature sweeps, coverage and prediction-set measurements, and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments and adds average class-coverage-gap results and numerical quantile-sample examples.

M1.justification: The TS procedures, LAC/APS/RAPS algorithms, and proposed separation of calibration and CP temperature selection remain unchanged. Revised theoretical conditions and expanded explanations do not introduce a different algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet classification coverage. The added metric and quantile-sample analyses concern datasets and models already studied, without introducing a new task or test environment.

E2.justification: The corresponding experiments retain LAC, APS, and RAPS, while Appendix D retains the comparison against Mondrian CP using RAPS. Newly cited related studies are not added as evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: v4 adds AvgCovGap, averaging coverage deviations across all classes, with evaluations at alpha = 0.1 and 0.05 using 10% CP sets in Appendix B.5.3. Existing reported splits, training settings, and temperature sweeps are retained. The changed Figure 2 does not explain its different displayed sample-index range.

E4.justification: v4 adds checks of whether the temperature trends persist under AvgCovGap and quantile-sample similarity examples in Appendix B.6. Figure 2's supporting correlation analysis is revised. Conversely, v3 Appendix A.1.1's direct numerical check of the gap-function approximation is removed.

E5.justification: Both versions report median-of-means over 100 randomized calibration/CP selections and show three separate single-trial examples in Appendix C. No changed seed counts, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty-reporting procedures are documented.

E6.justification: Tables 1–10 retain identical values. v4 adds AvgCovGap curves and quantile-sample vectors, replaces Figure 2's numerical curves, and removes the numerical approximation checks and theoretical/empirical critical-temperature comparisons. For C = 100 and delta-z approximately 8, the stated T > 1 range changes from 1.25–4.81 to 1.25–2.33.

T1.justification: Proposition 4.3/A.3 replaces conditions over all partial sums with conditions at L−1 or LT−1, explicitly addressing size-one cases and rewriting the proof. v4 also corrects the auxiliary lemma proof and changes the T > 1 bound factor from (T−1)/(T+1) to T/(T+1) in Theorem 4.4/A.4. These substantially revise the central theoretical argument and its sufficient conditions.

C1.justification: The introduction narrows the novelty claim from an uninvestigated interplay to one that remains largely unexplored. The principal contributions concerning the TS trade-off, non-monotonic behavior, theoretical explanation, and practitioner guidelines remain. The abstract and conclusion retain broader novelty wording.

C2.justification: v4 removes the asserted close numerical agreement between theoretical and empirical critical temperatures and the statement that theory can approximate the scan limit. It expands the rationale for the retained quantile-sample assumption and interprets AvgCovGap as corroborating the existing coverage trends.

D1.justification: Section 5 adds a project-code repository pointer for reproducing experiments and applying the guidelines. v3 only supplies the retained Torchvision training-reference link. Training hyperparameters and hardware disclosures in Appendices B.1–B.2 remain unchanged; repository availability was not checked externally.

R1.justification: v4 adds Xi et al. (2024) and Gupta et al. (2020), discussing concurrent TS/CP research and earlier binary-classification theory. It distinguishes the paper through temperature-range coverage, class-conditional evaluation, LAC comparisons, and multiclass analysis.

P1.justification: There are localized rewrites of theoretical explanations and proofs, movement of existing metric definitions from Appendix B.4 into Section 3.1, appendix reorganization, and an added impact statement. Running headers and publication information are corrected. The overall narrative and section structure remain recognizable.

P2.justification: v4 adds Figures 14–15 for AvgCovGap, redraws Figures 2–3, improves several plot sizes or resolutions, and corrects Figure 7's model headings. Figures and tables are relocated through reflow, while the ten table structures and overall document format remain largely unchanged.

improvement.justification: The corrected bound algebra and auxiliary proof, clearer proposition, added metric checks, and code-access information provide a limited net improvement. Benefits are tempered by removal of the direct gap-approximation check and inconsistencies in the new supporting examples: Appendix B.6's ImageNet-ResNet152 T = 2 top-five softmax entries sum to approximately 1.000192, exceeding 1. The quantile-sample approximation therefore remains incompletely validated.
